description: Resolves the ξ_2 flip-flop on conj:casimir-epsilon-vacuum. Shows the ξ_k=0 calibration is circular and that ξ_2 is gated on the N_⊙ construction: normalized Markov trace of identity ≡ 1 ∀q (tautological ξ_k=0), unnormalized weight sum diverges with n.

finding_A_calibration_is_circular.claim: casimir_beta_2_derivation.py derives ξ_k=0 by imposing ε = ε_0·ℏ_q² so the 1/ℏ_q² in Geom_ε cancels.
finding_A_calibration_is_circular.verdict: CIRCULAR — the calibration is chosen to produce the cancellation; it is an assumption, not a derivation.

finding_B1_normalized_trace_identically_.functional: Σ_λ y_λ(q)·dim(λ)  (normalized Markov trace of identity)
finding_B1_normalized_trace_identically_.verdict: ≡ 1 for ALL q (Wenzl normalization). ξ_k=0 under this reading is TAUTOLOGICAL — no Casimir-specific content.

finding_B2_unnormalized_weight_diverges_.verdict: q-dependent; relative h²-coefficient grows with n. A divergent, n-dependent ξ_2 is inadmissible for a single observable → naive 'prefactor = Markov trace on H_n(q)' needs ζ-regularization (the q-independent step).

finding_B3_survey_numbers_not_reproducib.verdict: Survey 'tr_M(1)' matches neither Σy_λ·dim (≡1) nor Σy_λ. Internally fits −0.123·C(n,2) for n=2,3,4; n=5 is an outlier. Non-reproducible numbers should not anchor a closure.

conclusion.xi_even_ge_2: OPEN — gated on the N_⊙ construction (sub-problem 1)
conclusion.xi_2_equals_zero_status: defensible ONLY as the content-free 'normalized trace of identity is 1'; any Casimir-specific mode weighting reintroduces q-dependence. The casimir-xi-2-equals-zero closure is RETRACTED to OPEN.

caveats: This probe is an audit support for the ξ_2 reconciliation; it does NOT construct N_⊙. ξ_2's value remains gated on sub-problem 1.
